events.title: Demo Update version 7
events.summary: Steam Demo UpdateHey Star Watchers! Thank you so much to everyone who's played the Leviticus Demo so far! We've recently passed over 1000 people that have checked out the Demo! Thanks to all the people that have played the game far and given feedback and support it means the world to us. To keep you all satiated while we work on the meaty new features for the full release we've done some major rebalancing and performance fixes to solve some of the issues older harder was having. events.title: Demo Update!
events.summary: Steam Demo Update Hey Soldiers of GOD! Thank you so much to everyone who has played the Leviticus Demo so far! We recently reached just under 900 people get the Demo! which is absolutely INSANE to us! We genuinely can't thank you enough for checking out the game and supporting us.Because of that, we wanted to give the Demo a little more love! The Demo now goes all the way to Round 30 and we've added 3 more upgrades from the full game for you to use: Celestial Ordnance The moon answers your call.
